medicalHistory.notes: Recovered fully after a 7-day course of Azithromycin.
Monitoring blood pressure daily. Advised low sodium diet and regular cardio.

prescriptions.dosage: 1 tablet by mouth daily in the morning on empty stomach

dischargeSummaries.medications:
• Cardireninum 5 mg (Tablet) - 1 tablet by mouth daily in the morning on empty stomach
• Lisinopril 10mg - 1 tablet daily in the morning
dischargeSummaries.recoveryNotes:
1. Follow up with primary care physician in 14 days for vital review.
2. Take all prescribed medications exactly as scheduled. Do not discontinue antibiotics prematurely.
3. Rest and avoid physical strain or heavy lifting above 10 lbs.
4. Return to emergency clinic immediately if fever exceeds 101°F or severe pain occurs.

medicalHistory.notes: Managing with Metformin and dietary controls. HbA1c is currently stable at 6.4%.
